blocks.html: Konvy Beauty officially opens its first-ever flagship store at Robinsons Galleria, marking a major milestone in the brand’s growing presence in the Philippines.
Founded in Thailand in 2012 as an online beauty store, Konvy Beauty has since grown into one of Southeast Asia’s most trusted e-commerce destinations for all things beauty and skincare.

Since entering the Philippine market in 2023 through its official stores on Lazada and Shopee, Konvy has made it easy for Filipino beauty enthusiasts to shop authentic beauty products online. Now, the brand takes the experience offline, bringing its signature sense of play, discovery and authenticity with its first physical retail space in Robinsons Galleria.

The flagship store offers hundreds of brands and thousands of products, featuring a curated mix of global favorites alongside beloved Thai, local, and K-beauty picks. Every product at Konvy is 100% genuine, giving shoppers the confidence to mix, match, and try new trends without worry.

“The opening of our first flagship store in the Philippines is an exciting step for Konvy Beauty as we continue to grow in the market,” said JC Chen, CCO of Konvy. “Our partnership with Robinsons Malls allows us to bring Konvy’s fun, authentic, and discovery-driven beauty experience closer to Filipino shoppers.”

Following its successful soft opening in Robinsons Galleria last December 2025, Konvy Beauty PH officially opens its doors with exciting in-store activities and exclusive treats for shoppers. Customers who spend PHP 999 on a single receipt can enjoy a chance to play the Konvy Claw Machine with one token equivalent to one play. Shoppers who spend PHP 799 on a single receipt can also access the Konvy Photo Booth. More freebies await the first 100 customers, making the opening day celebration even more rewarding.
Konvy Beauty is located on Level 2 of Robinsons Galleria, Ortigas. The store welcomes customers daily from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM.
For information regarding upcoming promotions and official announcements, follow Konvy Beauty and Robinsons Malls on their respective social media accounts.
